summary: This Phase 3 clinical trial is testing the drug vicadrostat combined with empagliflozin in adults with type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure, and cardiovascular disease. The sponsor, Boehringer Ingelheim, is currently recruiting 11800 participants for the study. Researchers want to compare the combination of vicadrostat and empagliflozin against a placebo matching Vicadrostat taken with empagliflozin. A placebo is an inactive substance that looks like the real medicine but has no active ingredients.
